ProgramUnit.Name: SELECT_CUST_WITH_CONTR_NEW
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE select_cust_with_contr_new (entry in VARCHAR2, include in VARCHAR2, cust_id out VARCHAR2) is
 --
 -- this procedure allows user to select customer by entering a few
 -- leading characters of customer name, it will return the proper
 -- customer id or display a short list of matching customers
 --
 -- entry : user entry for search
 -- include : customer_types to be included
 -- cust_id : return customer_id
 --
 -- Modified on 05/08/2011; Cursor modified to add sysdate as input parameter (based on timezone enabled parameter); IM:5412; AV;
-- tmpp 
 select_lov boolean; 
-- tmpp
 inlist VARCHAR2(1000);
 chap_id varchar2(4) := name_in('GLOBAL.chapter_id');
 cursor c1(pl_sysdate IN DATE) is select code
 from vserv_customer_type where pl_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, pl_sysdate+1) 
 union 
 select code
 from vserv_master 
 where code_type = 'DCUST' 
 and pl_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, pl_sysdate+1) 
 order by 1;
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
BEGIN
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 --
 
 --
 -- set up list of customer types to be included
 if include is null
 then
 for c1rec in c1(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 inlist :=inlist||c1rec.code||',';
 --next_record;
 end loop;
 inlist :=''''||rtrim(inlist,',')||'''';
 -- inlist := 'AH,DI,EX,MG,PA,RD,RG'; -- all customer types
 else
 inlist := include;
 end if;
 --
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where customer_id = entry
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 begin
 select customer_id into cust_id
 from customers
 where upper(name) like entry || '%'
 and instr(inlist,customer_type) > 0
 and chapter_id = chap_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1)
 and exists
 (select 'x' from vserv_contracts
 where chapter_id = chap_id
 and customer_id = customers.customer_id
 and chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,chp_sysdate+1));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0302'); -- invalid customer
 check_package_failure;
 when TOO_MANY_ROWS
 then
 -- cust_id := '';
 --list_values; -- tmpp
 -- tmpp
 select_lov:=show_lov('CONTROL_BLO_CUSTOMER_ID_LOV2');
 If not select_lov then
 message('List is not selected');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End if;
 -- tmpp

 end;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 tackle_error('Customers, Contracts');
 check_package_failure;

END;
